4. The plaintiff also alleged that except the suit water reservoir there was no water reservoir within the vicinity for service as aforesaid. The plaintiffs alleged that the defendants Nos. •1-4 were giving out that they had taken settlement of the suit reservoir and their names have been recorded in the S.A. Khatian without any basis. The defendants were trying to fill up the water reservoir with earth. This gave rise to cause of action in the suit and prayers for injunction. 

 5. The defendants Nos. 1 and 2 contested the suit by filing written statements. Their case is that the suit plot No.3143, 3144, 3146 of khatian No.504 of MohallaTalihaor, Sylhet Town are low lying ditches. They originally belonged to Khan Bahadur Estate. These lands along with other lands were souled with Sudanshu Mohan Das. The plain- till No.1 of the present suit brought title Suit No. 70/69 against the Province of East Bengal and others and that he as a lessee Of the cattle market all along used the water of the said ditch for washing the cattle and the Government could not lease out the same to anyone. 

 6. An area of 3 poas 5 jasthis land contiguous to the south of C.S. Plot No.3 146 was souled with the defendant No. I by Khan Bahadur Wakf Estate in •1960 and the defendant No.1 had . been in actual possession of the same. This land which is now in suit is covered by the C.S. Dag Nos. 3145 and 3145/ 3292 under khatian No.392/2 and they have been re- corded as Doba in the name of defendant No.1. 

 11. I am of the view that the learned courts below did not consider the different aspects of customary right which were necessary for finding such a right while disposing of the suit. Proper points were not formulated and disposed of. In view of these, the 'decision of the appellate court cannot be sustained and the suit should go back on remand for fresh decision on the evidence on record. Mr. Dewan A.M.S. - Zaman the learned Advocate for the appellant has pointed out that the appellate court also did not consider 2 of their important Exts. namely S.A. Khatian the plaint of the title suit No. 70/69 Ext. E. He has urged that the khatian would show that the customary right claimed by the plaintiffs were not noted in the suit plot although there is provision for it in rule 18(1) of the State Acquisition & Tenancy Act and Ext. would show that the plaintiff .did not make any statement as to the customary right of the plaintiffs in respect of the present suit. Whatsoever be the merit of these two exts. the learned Appellate court below ought to have considered them. Therefore these 2 exts. along with other evidence on record bearing open local user of the water of the suit water reservoir in the manner required should be considered.
